Title: Tables and columns deployed
Gherkin: Given the ACE schema at the common migration head, when V027 is applied in DEV and SIT, then the 14 tables and 12 columns exist, ace_batch_run has its keys, and no existing column changes.

Title: Every Workbench field is populated
Gherkin: Given one full file per source, when ACE ingests each for 2026-11-30, then all 80 fields hold a value or an explicit null and each target count equals the trailer.

Title: Business date and completion recorded
Gherkin: Given the ALS file for 2026-11-30 completes at 04:40, when the Workbench reads v_ace_batch_status, then it returns ALS, 2026-11-30, COMPLETED, the count and the time; a later failed run does not replace it.

Title: Read grant only
Gherkin: Given the view-owner role, when the grant is applied, then it selects the 14 new tables and writes nothing; the 12 new columns are covered by the Tier 1 grant.

Title: Reversible
Gherkin: Given a copy with the migration applied, when the down script runs, then the 14 tables and 12 columns are gone and ACE row counts are unchanged.

Title: Existing ACE reads unaffected
Gherkin: Given the ACE regression suite, when it runs after the migration, then every existing screen, job and report passes.

Title: Idempotent reload
Gherkin: Given a file already ingested for a business date, when it is ingested again, then no duplicate row exists and one batch row remains.

Title: Field appendix matches
Gherkin: Given the 80 appendix rows, when the conformance test runs, then 80 of 80 resolve to a column of the right type.
